One matplotlib figure and one small table, the fixture EXR-4 Phase 0 measures.

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

x = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 200)
plt.plot(x, np.sin(x))
plt.title("sin")
plt.show()
```
